body:
Hello! I think the problem is reproducible here, because `is_action` accepts an additional parameter `exact_match`, which is `false` by default:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/bc192293b13a8891cb8739a36d8c0736a5c4c4b8/doc/classes/InputEvent.xml#L39-L47

Because of this line if the parameter's value is `false` the direction of the event is not taken into account:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/bc192293b13a8891cb8739a36d8c0736a5c4c4b8/doc/classes/InputEvent.xml#L45

The issue is fixed for me with this piece of code:
```gdscript
func _gui_input(event: InputEvent):
	if event is not InputEventJoypadMotion:
		return

	# We are only interested in the left stick X axis for this test
	if event.axis != JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X:
		return

	if event.is_action(&"ui_left", true):
		printt("ui_left with axis value", event.axis_value)

	if event.is_action(&"ui_right", true):
		printt("ui_right with axis value", event.axis_value)
```
